pages.title: Recombinant DNA
pages.text: A double helix spliced together from more than one creature, its pieces joined by enzymes that cut and paste at precise sequences. It looks no different from any other DNA. It does things no single creature's DNA could.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Restriction enzymes cut genomes at precise points; ligases stitch them back. I let engineered enzymes splice two samples together in a nutrient broth, and the Gene Sequencer read back a genome that had never existed before.
